swimlanes.description: Execution-path and orchestration gaps that block reliable agent work.

swimlanes.label: Enterprise
swimlanes.description: Open enterprise-facing roadmap seams and partial delivery items.

swimlanes.label: Deferred

meta.scratchpad: Roadmap tracker seeded from docs/technical-status.md. This tracker currently covers live open and deferred items; completed history stays in the technical status doc.

tasks.title: Close long packet/file-pointer completion on the resident Claude lane
tasks.goal: Make longer prompt-file and artifact-driven Claude lane turns complete as reliably as the now-proven short direct turns.
tasks.blocker_reason: Short direct resident-Claude turns are proven, but longer packet/file-pointer turns still do not complete reliably on the interactive Claude backend.

context.notes: Roadmap item D0za in docs/technical-status.md remains the main active runtime gap.

tasks.title: Versioned admin/event APIs and read-access auditing
tasks.goal: Finish the external API/admin compatibility side of the enterprise integration surface now that event schema v1 is frozen.

context.notes: Technical status item 36 is only partially done: emitted events are versioned, but external API contracts, admin-surface versioning, and compatibility guarantees remain open.

tasks.title: Publish recipes through an npm registry package
tasks.goal: Add npm distribution for Guardrail recipes once the GitHub-based distribution path is proven stable.
tasks.blocker_reason: Deferred until the GitHub-based distribution path and registry ergonomics are proven.

tasks.title: Ship secret-mutation recipes
tasks.goal: Publish guarded secret-management recipes only once the product can support write-only secret input, runtime injection, revocation, and audit safely.
tasks.blocker_reason: Deferred until write-only secret-input UX, multi-stage approval, and guaranteed audit/log redaction are strong enough to ship secret-mutation recipes honestly.

tasks.title: Ship destructive cloud mutation recipes
tasks.goal: Publish destructive cloud-operation recipes only after Guardrail can bind resources/accounts, prove dry-run parity, and enforce strong multi-stage approval.
tasks.blocker_reason: Deferred until resource/account binding, destructive-change summaries, dry-run parity guarantees, and stronger multi-stage approval exist.
